Autogenerated size-class table and thresholds for allocator superblocks.

# Purpose
This header file defines the size class configuration for the `fd_alloc` memory allocator. It sets the threshold that separates small allocations from large ones, the total number of supported size classes, and the sentinel value used for large allocations. The `fd_alloc_sizeclass_cfg` table maps each size class to its superblock footprint, block footprint, block count, and concurrency group mask, so the allocator can place requests into fixed-size groups with controlled space use and search order. This data is used by the allocator at run time to manage small allocations through superblocks and to send larger requests directly to `fd_wksp_alloc`.
